caption:
Lunch-break verdict: Dalebrook Tidal Pool.
100% recommended, fully protected right now. 18°C in the water. Grab your towel.
Cloudy for most of the day.

Built in 1907, one of Cape Town's oldest and most beloved tidal pools in Kalk Bay, facing east to catch the morning sunrise over False Bay.
